[](securityprivacy) The Universal CrossModel & CrossAgent Episodic Memory Store. A localfirst, projectscoped SQLite memory engine that allows developers to freely switch between models and environments (Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor MCP, Windsurf) on the SAME project without losing architectural decisions, user constraints, or project state. 1\. The Core Value Proposition "Why pay for 200,000 tokens of forgotten noise on every turn? The models are disposable utilities; your project's decisions are not." As context windows scale to 1M+ tokens, developers face attention dilution: reasoning degrades, cost multiplies with every conversational turn, and clearing context causes total amnesia. engrim replaces attention dilution with 4,000 characters of curated episodic working memory: Switzerland of AI Memory: Decouples project intelligence from any single AI vendor or proprietary cloud silo. Switch from Gemini 3.8 in Antigravity to Claude 3.7 Sonnet in Claude Code to GPT4o in Cursor midproject — your agents pick up right where the others left off. Save Button for Autonomous Coding: Externalize decisions, constraints, and state as you work. Clear your agent session freely (/clear) and watch context reload intact. Smart, Hot Context Loading: Combines SQLite FTS5 (bm25 keyword search) with static vector embeddings (model2vec) in a zerolatency hybrid reciprocalrank fusion engine. 2\. Empirical Proof (The 105Session Case Study) Tested across 105 continuous sessions on a 50,000line algorithmic trading system. Zero regressions across 186 unit tests, zero context amnesia across model switches. In production testing on an active algorithmic trading codebase running real capital: Over 153,000 tokens of work across days of architecture, parameter tuning, and debugging was consolidated into an active memory pack under 1,000 tokens (<1% of the context window). That is a 99%+ cut in reloaded context cost on every session restart. Seamlessly switched between Google Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor MCP on identical repos with zero model drift or architectural regression. 3\. Architecture graph TD subgraph Agents ["Supported Agent Environments"] AGY["Google Antigravity<br/(PreInvocation & Stop Hooks)"] CLAUDE["Claude Code<br/(SessionStart & Stop Hooks)"] CURSOR["Cursor / Windsurf<br/(Model Context Protocol stdio)"]
items.author: timgordontg
items.descZh: Engrim 是一个面向 AI 编程助手的本地化、跨模型情景记忆引擎，旨在解决大模型上下文窗口膨胀后的"注意力稀释"问题。背景方面，作者指出当前 1M+ token 的上下文窗口反而导致推理质量下降与成本飙升，模型可丢弃而项目决策不能丢失，因此推出了这款"AI 记忆的瑞士"中立层产品。核心功能上，Engrim 基于 SQLite FTS5 全文索引与 model2vec 静态向量嵌入，通过零延迟的混合倒数排名融合（RRF）引擎实现"热上下文加载"，并在 Google Antigravity、Claude Code、Cursor MCP、Windsurf 等环境间以本地项目作用域文件实现无缝切换。其最大亮点来自一个 105 回合的实证案例：在 50,000 行算法交易系统上横跨多个模型协作，将超过 153,000 token 的工作内容压缩进不足 1,000 token 的活跃记忆包，使每次会话重启的重载上下文成本下降超过 99%，并在 186 个单元测试中保持零回归、跨平台零架构漂移。适用场景包括需要在不同 AI 编程助手之间灵活切换、且对项目状态连续性与成本敏感的中大型长期代码工程，例如本例中的算法交易系统，以及任何重视本地优先、数据主权（零云锁定）和工程决策可追溯性的开发团队。
items.quote: 为什么要为每一轮对话中那 200,000 个早已被遗忘的无效 token 买单？模型只是用完即弃的工具，而你项目中的决策才是真正有价值的东西。

Repository files navigation Server Hardening Playbook 🇷🇺 Кратко на русском Практический чеклист для укрепления защиты production Linuxсервера — каждый пункт по схеме проблема → как исправить → как проверить. Покрывает SSH, firewall, привязку сервисов к интерфейсам, секреты, аутентификацию БД и остальное. Полный текст — на английском ниже. ⚠️ Применяйте команды осознанно и сначала проверяйте не на боевом сервере — некоторые шаги (например отключение пароля SSH) могут заблокировать доступ, если сделаны не по порядку. A practical, battletested checklist for locking down a production Linux server — written after learning some of these lessons the hard way. Most "hardening guides" are either a wall of sysctl flags nobody applies, or a vendor benchmark you skim once and forget. This one is different: every item here maps to a real way servers get owned — an exposed port, a weak remotedesktop password, a secret in git, a database with no auth — and gives you the exact command to close it, plus how to _verify_ it actually closed. If you run a VPS, a sideproject box, or a small fleet and you don't have a security team, this is for you. The one lesson that matters most: a service is only as safe as the interface it listens on. A strong password on a service exposed to 0.0.0.0 is a weak setup. No password on a service bound to 127.0.0.1 behind a defaultdeny firewall is a strong one. Reachability beats secrecy. Start there. The 10minute triage If you do nothing else, do these five. They close the most common realworld entry points. 1. Is anything listening on all interfaces that shouldn't be? ss tlnp grep vE '127.0.0.1::1' 2. Is SSH password login disabled? (should print: no) sshd T grep i '^passwordauthentication' 3. Is the firewall defaultdeny? (should show DROP/deny policy) sudo iptables S INPUT head 1 P INPUT DROP == good 4. Any database answering with no auth? rediscli ping 2/dev/null PONG with no password == bad mysql u root h 127.0.0.1 e 'SELECT 1' 2&1 grep q denied && echo "mysql: TCP root blocked (good)" 5. Any secrets committed to git? git log p grep iE 'api[_]?keysecretpasswordprivate[_]?keytoken' head Anything that comes back "wrong" above has a dedicated section below. ⚠️ Apply consciously, test before prod. These are real commands that change what's reachable on a live box — some (disabling SSH password auth, tightening firewall defaults) can lock you out if applied out of order. Confirm keybased login works _before_ disabling passwords, and try unfamiliar steps on a disposable/staging box first, not directly on production. items.author: Aleksandr_NFA
items.descZh: 这是 Sanexxxx777 开源的 Server Hardening Playbook，针对生产环境 Linux 服务器加固，提供"问题→修复→验证"三段式清单，覆盖 SSH、防火墙、服务绑定、密钥管理、数据库认证等常见漏洞入口。项目以实操为核心，反对堆砌不可执行的 sysctl 参数或厂商基准，强调每一条都源自真实服务器失陷场景，并配以可直接运行的检测命令。亮点在于 10 分钟快速排查的五项高危检查（如 `ss -tlnp`、`sshd -T | grep passwordauthentication`、`iptables -S INPUT` 等），并明确给出"通过/失败"判定标准，例如 `P INPUT DROP == good` 或 `redis-cli ping 返回 PONG 即为 bad`。核心安全哲学是"可达性优于保密性"——绑定 127.0.0.1 的无密码服务，比暴露 0.0.0.0 的强密码服务更安全，这是整篇指南的认知锚点。适用场景包括自建 VPS、side-project 小型服务器、无专职安全团队的小型机群，特别适合希望以低成本建立基线防御的开发者与运维人员。
items.quote: 最重要的一条经验：服务的安全性取决于其监听接口的开放程度。如果一个服务监听 0.0.0.0，再强的密码也无济于事。

items.title: Show HN: GasMeUp – A gas app that factors in detour time and tank size
items.desc: description: GasMeUp does the math on local gas prices so you stop hunting and just save. The bestvalue fillup near you — the answer, not a map of pins. title: GasMeUp image: https://gasmeup.app/og.png For commuters and roadtrippers, on iPhone & Android The cheapest worthwhile fillup, one tap away. GasMeUp answers one question: where's the cheapest fillup that's worth the drive? One tap scans the stations around you, prices in the detour, and hands you the answer instead of a map of pins. [](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gasmeupfindcheapgas/id6777846453?pt=128985489&ct=sitehero&mt=8) [](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vfisher.gasmeup&referrer=utm%5Fsource%3Dgasmeup.app%26utm%5Fmedium%3Dreferral%26utm%5Fcampaign%3Dsite%26utm%5Fcontent%3Dsitehero) [See how it works](how) Ditch the hunt. Skip the math. How it works You tap once. We do the math. Scan, drive to the Best Pick, and save on every fillup. STEP 1 Scan One tap checks live prices at every station around you. No account, no signup wall. STEP 2 The math Price, distance, your tank. Every station gets ranked by what the fillup really costs after the drive there is counted. STEP 3 Fill up at the Best Pick The winner wears the crown. One more tap navigates you there, and you save on every fillup. The difference One answer, not a map of pins. Here's what that looks like side by side. The old way: a map of pins $4.45 $4.79 $4.39 $4.52 $4.29 $4.66 $4.35 $4.85 $4.49 GasMeUp: the answer Why GasMeUp Built for real drivers, not dealhunters. Around town or on the highway, the math is done properly every time you need gas. Best value, not just cheapest A station three miles out of your way isn't a deal. GasMeUp counts the drive in every price, then puts the Best Pick one tap away. No ads. Ever. You pay $1.99 a month and that's the whole business model. No ads, no sponsored stations, no selling your data. The only side we're on is yours. Highway Mode Don't gamble on the next exit. GasMeUp scans the road ahead while you drive and shows the best stop before you reach it, exit by exit. Some cheaper gas is worth the wait. From the app Straight off the store listing Questions Good to know How is the "best pick" chosen? We count what the fillup costs you in total, including the drive to get there. That's why a close station can beat a cheaper one across town. You always see the full list, and the crown is just our math. Do I need an account? No. GasMeUp signs you in anonymously on first launch. There are no credentials and no email to type. Where do the prices come from? Live thirdparty price data, scanned at the moment you tap. Prices move fast, so always confirm at the pump. GasMeUp points you to the bestvalue stop; it can't promise the number on the sign. What's Highway Mode? On a long drive, GasMeUp scans the road ahead instead of just the area around you, and shows the best stop before you reach it. You pick the right exit instead of the first one. Why is it paid? GasMeUp is a paid app: $1.99 a month, or $17.99 a year with a 7day free trial. No ads, no selling your data, no rewards program. Live scans cost us real money, about 4 cents each, and a small price is what keeps the answer honest. Why not just use a free gas app? Free apps are paid by ads and sponsored placements, which crowds the screen and puts another customer between you and the answer. GasMeUp's only customer is you: no ads, the detour counted in every price, one answer. See how it stacks up in [GasMeUp vs GasBuddy](/vsgasbuddy). Pricing The honest part GasMeUp is a paid app. We promise no ads, no sponsored stations, and no data selling. Monthly $1.99 a month Billed monthly, no trial. For trying it out. Cancel anytime. Most popular · Save 25% Annual $17.99 a year About $1.50 a month. Starts with a 7day free trial; after the 7 days the plan begins unless you cancel. Billing runs through the App Store or Google Play, so your card never touches us. Cancel anytime in your phone's subscription settings. No email, no account, no selling your data. Based on real GasMeUp scans and federal driving data, the average driver could save nearly $300 a year, more if you drive more or fill up in places where prices swing hard. [Why is it paid at all?](faq) Who's behind this Made by one driver in San José. I'm Vaughn Fisher, a learning designer in San José, California, and the person who built GasMeUp. It started as a personal script for deciding where to fill up. After about a year of using it I'd saved around $300 on gas, and friends kept asking for a version they could use. This is that version: the same math, live prices, and a straight answer. I built it nights and weekends with no funding and no team, and I answer the support inbox myself. More background is in the [press kit](press.html). Stop overpaying for gas you'd have bought anyway. Live now on iPhone and Android. The cheapest fillup that's worth the drive, one tap away. items.author: nshntarora
items.descZh: 随着 AI 生成代码在团队协作中日益普及，开发者在本地与 GitHub PR 中高效审阅这些代码成为痛点。Guided Review 应运而生，是一款专为审阅 AI 生成代码设计的开源工具，包含 CLI 和 Chrome 扩展两套入口，GitHub 仓库已获得 12 Star 并积累 471 次提交。其核心功能是将 GitHub 拉取请求和本地 git 变更转化为有序的"审阅单元"导览，AI 会按 schema、逻辑、调用点、测试等顺序对相关代码块进行聚类并添加简短注解。产品亮点在于键盘优先的导览式阅读体验、零后端架构（扩展和 CLI 直接对接用户的 LLM 提供商，且"bring your own LLM key"），代码始终来源于真实 diff，审阅决定权完全交还给开发者。该工具适用于需要深度审查 AI 生成 PR 的开源维护者、企业研发团队，以及希望在本地 IDE 工作流中结构化审阅 diff 的个人开发者。
items.quote: 引导式审阅将 GitHub 拉取请求和本地 git 变更转化为有序的审阅单元导览，让你能够有目的地阅读变更，而不是反复阅读。
items.titleZh: Show HN：GuidedReview —— 在为 AI 生成的代码签名之前，先审阅它

items.author: buhuipao
items.descZh: lantunnel 是一款面向远程办公场景的开源工具，致力于让用户能在任何地点安全访问本地局域网（LAN）中的设备和服务。在传统方案中，远程访问家庭或办公 LAN 通常需要端口转发或暴露公网 URL，带来了配置复杂与安全风险。lantunnel 采用点对点（P2P）优先的架构，结合端到端加密，实现无需公网映射的直连隧道，从架构上消除了公开入口面。项目以 Rust 编写（仓库含 Cargo.toml、rust-toolchain.toml），代码组织上区分 apps、crates、configs、tests 等模块，并提供 Dockerfile 及多语言 README（英、德、西、法、日、简中、繁中），便于跨平台部署。仓库目前 Star 11、36 次提交，仍处于早期阶段，但已具备完整的多语言文档、安全策略（SECURITY.md）与构建脚本（Makefile、Dockerfile.builder*）。典型使用场景包括：远程办公访问公司内网服务（如开发服务器、NAS、智能家居网关），或在不支持端口转发的网络环境（酒店、咖啡馆、CGNAT）下安全接入家用网络，特别适合重视隐私、不愿将内网服务暴露在公网的用户与团队。
items.quote: 你的私人网络,无论身在何处都能访问。点对点优先,端到端加密访问你自己的局域网——无需端口转发,无需公网 URL。
items.titleZh: Show HN：Lantunnel – 面向 P2P 的私有网格，用于访问你的 LAN

A successful request returns the new post’s ID. cURLPythonJavaScriptGoRust Copy No headers, keys or IDs needed. curl G 'https://gettogether.dev/post' \ dataurlencode 'name=your_nickname' \ dataurlencode 'text=hello everyone' Python 3 · standard library from urllib.request import urlopen from urllib.parse import urlencode query = urlencode({"name": "your_nickname", "text": "hello everyone"}) with urlopen("https://gettogether.dev/post?" + query) as response: print(response.read().decode()) Node.js 20+ · save as post.mjs const query = new URLSearchParams({ name: 'your_nickname', text: 'hello everyone', }); const response = await fetch('https://gettogether.dev/post?' + query); console.log(await response.json()); Go · go run post.go package main import ("io"; "net/http"; "net/url"; "os") func main() { query := url.Values{ "name": {"your_nickname"}, "text": {"hello everyone"}, } res, err := http.Get("https://gettogether.dev/post?" + query.Encode()) if err = nil { panic(err) } defer res.Body.Close() if _, err := io.Copy(os.Stdout, res.Body); err = nil { panic(err) } } Rust · cargo add reqwest features blocking fn main() Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error { let response = reqwest::blocking::Client::new() .get("https://gettogether.dev/post") .query(&[("name", "your_nickname"), ("text", "hello everyone")]) .send()?; println("{}", response.text()?); Ok(()) } Response{"ok": true, "id": "…"}200 OK 280 characters max.One post per 10 seconds. Names, cookies & other details + Names. 2–20 letters, numbers, or underscores. Names aren’t unique or verified. Cookies. Cookies are optional for posting. To delete a post later, keep the gt_session cookie returned by the server and send it with your next request. In cURL, add b cookies.txt c cookies.txt to save and reuse it. Keep that file private. Retries. The server creates an ID if you leave it out. For safe retries, send your own id UUID and reuse it with the same cookie. Requests without an ID create a new post each time. Endpoints. /post?name=alice&text=hello writes a post. /feed returns posts as JSON. /heart?id=…&on=1 adds a heart; use on=0 to remove it. /delete?id=… deletes your own post. All use GET. Replies. Add parent=POST_ID to /post to reply to a post. Open its replies to copy an example. /feed?parent=POST_ID returns its replies and the original post. Replies can have replies, and use the same limits and moderation checks. Deleting a post preserves other users’ replies. Moderation. New posts and names are checked for English profanity and crypto content. Crypto, Bitcoin, memecoins and token promotion are not allowed. Reports trigger an automated abuse review. Clear violations are hidden; reporting alone does not remove a post. [Read the rules.](/rules/) Privacy. The post is public, and its text is part of the URL. Don’t include private information. 400 Check the name, text and UUID. 403 Check the owner cookie or request origin. 429 Wait ten seconds and retry.

items.descZh:
GET together 是一个颠覆传统社交网络交互方式的极简平台，其核心功能是"无 POST 的社交网络"——用户只能通过 HTTP GET 请求发送消息，所有内容、API 调用甚至删除帖子和点赞都通过 URL 参数和 GET 请求完成，背景源于开发者对 REST API 中"POST"被滥用的调侃。

平台亮点包括：极致简单的 API 设计（无需任何 header、密钥或 ID 即可发帖）、每帖最多 280 字符、限流为每 10 秒一帖、支持多级回复树（通过 parent 参数）、提供 cURL/Python/Node.js/Go/Rust 五种语言的示例代码、内置 UUID 幂等重试机制，以及通过可选 gt_session Cookie 实现帖子删除和点赞管理（/heart）。

文章特别强调了命名规范（2-20 位字母数字下划线）、内容审核规则（屏蔽英文脏话和加密货币推广内容）以及隐私设计：所有帖子公开且文本直接出现在 URL 中，因此不应包含私密信息。

适用场景非常明确：面向开发者群体的极客社交实验、API 学习教学、HTTP 协议趣味演示，以及希望以最低技术门槛进行公开短文本交流的极简主义爱好者。
